I made a website for calculating important character stats for your live matches.

The site has ALOT of functions. So here's a rundown for anyone interested.

Overview : The site provides analysis of individuals and teams (including their runes and mastery selection) to help you plan your strategies, from deciding if and how to invade to where your late game stats compare to enemies and teammates. There is also news from 3 sources, currently live streamers on Twitch and Azubu, and a list of popular add-ons for LoL.

FEATURES

- The Front Page -

On the front page, there is a newsy section that pulls from here, S@20, and Riot and does some minor filtration to avoid repeated news. There is also a section that shows the streamers currently online on Twitch and Azubu. That section gives the very top streamer first and the 3 after are randomized selections of the top 9.

There's also a link for social media following, a character builder link. and a link to a list of addons available for league.

- Live Game Page -

This is where the bread and butter is. The live game page shows an abundance of information.

  • In the header area: you can click on any of the links and it will automatically open up that sites match analysis for your match. So you can easily check your match on LoLskill, carry.gg, lolnexus, and OP.GG.

  • At the top left and right: you can see the two selected players individual stats that are calculated with runes and mastery included. As well as what types of damage they deal (magic or physical or both) as well as all the types of CC associated with that character. you can change these by clicking on a characters graph icon (more on that later)

  • Inbetween that: There's all of the characters currently in the match. The bar graphs show there level one highest Burst Damage, AA DPS, and effective healths. There's also a 'counter warning' that tells you if a character has been hard countered. You can click on the large character portraits to open up the characters wiki and their champion.gg page. You can click on the counter image to open up the championselect.net page for that match-up, which is a community resource for dealing with specific match-ups. If you click on the players name, it opens up another page with that players op.gg profile.

  • The Red and Blue Graph icons: located below the character portraits are clickable and select a character to graph in either the red or blue posistion. when you click on them you should notice the stats before change to give exact values (with runes and masteries) of character statsas well as change the line graphs located directly below.

  • The line Graphs (character): The graphs give players an idea of the characters interpolated burst damage, natural dps, and effective healths for up to level 18. you can change who is shown in the graphs and data by selecting the red or blue graph icon buttons by that characters portrait. The graphs can help you plan how you will play against your lane enemies as well as give you information about later game limitations.

  • Below that there some images and numbers: This is the Level 1 invade information center. On each side it tells you who has the statistical advantage in an invade scenario, ~~purple~~ red team or blue team. In-between that there are some icons that tell you which color team has the advantage in which area. You can hover over each icon to see the breakdown for each team. The color of the icon gives you a quick look at which team has the advantage and the number value tells you by how much they have the advantage. This is a big help to give you an idea if you should invade or not. e.g.- if you have an advantage in dps but not burst, you might want to plan an invade to take advantage of team constant damage strats and avoid any strat that relies more on doing burst.

  • The next set of line graphs is the TEAM graph area: This does the same thing as the character line graph area but for the entirety of each team from levels 1 through 18. this gives you an idea about your playstyle, whether you should be doing all-ins or kiting or focus bursting or steady DPSing.

  • The last bit is experimental strategy suggetions automatically generated by the character stats: So this will analyze your characters and advise you how to play in three increments. From level 1-5, 5-11, and 12-18. Click on the 'more info' tab to expand the reasoning. On each side are the 1v1 suggestions. These are tied to the characters you selected to graph above. So the offense area will say things like "cautious" and "poke" if you have higher burst but lower DPS. the defense area will say things like "risky" and "tougher" if you have higher effective healths (both for physical and magical damage). This tells you what kind of laning style you should consider given the character limitations. Inbetween the 1v1 sections are the team sections. These do the same thing as the 1v1 areas but consider the entirety of both teams.

whew! That's a lot of stuff for your LoL gaming!

-Lobby Helper-

this was set-up to be a smaller manual version of the Live Game page. You can click on character portraits and it will give you counters automatically as well as base stats and keep a running total of each teams magic damage, physical damage, and CC. This will tell you what you are lacking or have a high amount of while you are in the lobby and help you pick an optimal team comp in these areas. there's also line graphs similar to the team line graphs in the Live Game page.

-Add-ons-

This page is a list of helpful or fun add-ons for LoL that i have found on the web and also where to find them.

Advertisements

A note about advertisements: All advertisements are located in an out of the way place and I will aim to keep them as non-intrusive as possible. The source of the Ads is Google Adsense. Right now you never really even see them unless you want to and I want to keep it that way. With that said, I will probably need your impressions to keep the site alive and keep improving on it for you all. So please please whitelist and allow me to earn your trust.

Anyway, lots of info is available for you to optimize your strategies. I'll be around off and on today to answer any questions and feedback is always appreciated.

Thanks so much for any support. GL HF!

Why are deep sea creatures so alien looking compared to the species living on upper levels?
"Alien looking" is in the eye of the beholder.

Because of how scarce other fish are at such extreme depths, the bodies must be built to last for much longer lengths of time without food. This requires organisms to have much higher swimming efficiency resulting in more eel-like species. This morphology impairs predation, as organisms lose the ability to accelerate quickly. This promotes other adaptations to improve predation like "snaggle-toothed" mouths or voluminous stomachs, or improve odds of escape like being very spiny or being armoured.
I'd think the opinion that they're "alien looking" is simply because they're not seen often. If you think about it, a shrimp looks pretty "alien", but we're used to it.
I imagine the deep sea creatures find us pretty weird looking as well. They have adapted to their environment just as we have.
